definition.signal_pool: same fixed selected classical pattern pool as intermarket filter research
definition.volatility: ATR14 versus its causal EMA960; expanding also exceeds ATR 48 bars earlier
definition.own_trend: 960-bar log return (same elapsed time as 320 15m bars)
definition.currency_strength_expanding: directional 240-bar basket-strength gap is positive and larger than 240 bars earlier
definition.gold_usd_inverse_regime: gold and basket USD 960-bar trends are currently opposite, then gold confirms the USD pair direction
definition.sessions: historical DST-aware local market hours; overlaps assigned NY, then London, then Tokyo
definition.exit: strict RR 1:1 full exit; same-bar ambiguity is loss

selection_rule.adoption: development rule plus expectancy > 0 in 2023-2024 and 2025-2026
